per_article_summaries: Aston Martin will introduce a major upgrade package for the first time this season. The new parts will primarily aim to correct the weaknesses of the AMR26 chassis. The next improvements to the Honda engine will arrive after the summer break. Lance Stroll says Hungary will be the real moment of truth for Aston Martin.

Max Verstappen fastest in opening practice session at Belgian Grand Prix. Red Bull driver just over a tenth clear of Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli was a tenth behind Verstappen. Oscar Piastri was forced to bring his McLaren back to the garage.

Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar is set to start this weekend's Belgian Grand Prix from the back of the grid. Hadjar has been given his fifth internal combustion engine, turbocharger and exhaust system, exceeding his season's maximum allowance of four. McLaren's Lando Norris will also move to the back of the grid because he is taking his fifth battery of the season, exceeding his allowance of four.

Haas has scored just three points since the April break. The Ferrari-powered VF-26 now struggles to make it out of Q1. Team principal Ayao Komatsu doesn't deny that his side has been outdeveloped by its rivals.

Former Formula 1 driver Jolyon Palmer believes Carlos Sainz is "getting nowhere" in his attempts to lead Williams out of its current performance slump. Palmer addressed recent comments from Sainz, who admitted to feeling frustrated and concerned after an upgraded front wing on the FW48 failed to produce the anticipated performance gains.

Pierre Gasly crashed at the end of Free Practice 2 ahead of Belgian Grand Prix. Frenchman experienced a snap of oversteer at the exit of Les Fagnes section. Franco Colapinto was seventh-fastest in FP2, outpacing second-quickest midfield car.

Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad have both scored points in recent races. But Racing Bulls was only able to bring one of its updates to one car. Team principal Alan Permane decided to make it a mini competition between his drivers.

Max Verstappen is completely justified in evaluating his options outside of Red Bull, says Sky Sports F1 pundit Naomi Schiff. The 28-year-old has repeatedly been linked to moves to Mercedes or McLaren. Verstappen has an exit clause in his contract that gives him the option to leave the team if he is outside the top two in the drivers' standings by the summer break.

James Hinchcliffe says Red Bull has gone from having too few drivers in its pipeline to too many. The former IndyCar Series driver was speaking on the F1 Nation podcast. Hinchcliffe believes Red Bull's success has led to a bottleneck in the team's academy.

Cadillac launched its first-ever livery during a Super Bowl halftime ad. The US-owned team has now moved to a more conventional design. Cadillac first rolled out its updated symmetrical, white-on-black livery over the Austrian Grand Prix weekend.

Guenther Steiner says Aston Martin will need a 'miracle' to catch Williams. The former Haas team principal made the comments on The Red Flags Podcast. Aston Martin sits 10th in the constructors' championship with just one point.

Kimi Antonelli finished the final practice session on top of the timesheets. Lewis Hamilton crashed at the end of the session on the exit of Turn 13. Lando Norris and Max Verstappen slotted into second and third.

Aston Martin has been well off the pace with both its car and its Honda power unit from day one. The Silverstone squad is having to grind through its toughest weekend yet at high-speed Spa-Francorchamps. Friday practice in Hungary will reveal if there is light at the end of a very long tunnel for Aston Martin in 2026.

Max Verstappen praised Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar for delivering him "a tow and a half" in Formula 1 qualifying at the Belgian Grand Prix. The team opted to use Hadjar's slipstream in the final sector, through the Blanchimont sweep and on the approach to the final chicane. Kimi Antonelli then pressed home an advantage and collected pole by three tenths.

Mercedes driver George Russell was 0.508s off team-mate Kimi Antonelli’s pole lap. Russell says top speed difference between the two works Mercedes can’t be fully accounted for in terms of driving style alone.

Esteban Ocon will start from 17th on the grid at Belgian Grand Prix. Haas driver failed to make it through Q1 for the fifth time in last six races. Ocon's VF-26 is suffering from a top-speed issue, which team can't resolve.

Carlos Sainz questions how the rules could be accepted as-is from the simulations. The Spaniard expected a "sketchy" opening lap to the race. Lewis Hamilton agreed that the teams and drivers had seen the issues coming "straight away"

Max Verstappen says F1 drivers are losing power through Pouhon. The Dutchman qualified second for the Belgian Grand Prix on Saturday. Fernando Alonso and Oscar Piastri have also criticised the 2026 regulations. Pouhon, the fast double left-hander, isn't even a corner anymore, says Lando Norris.

Charles Leclerc was incorrectly shown a yellow flag at the end of Belgian Grand Prix qualifying, which cost him a place on the grid. In the dying seconds of qualifying, Leclerc was 0.070s up on his first run when he entered the Bus Stop chicane. But as qualifying had finished, a yellow flag was out on pitlane while parc ferme was being formed.

Kimi Antonelli on pole ahead of Red Bull's Max Verstappen at Belgian GP. But engine changes and new parts mean several cars will take penalties. Lando Norris, Lance Stroll, Isack Hadjar and Fernando Alonso will all take grid penalties.

Kimi Antonelli secures his sixth Formula 1 pole position of the year. Italian beats Max Verstappen by 0.317s in Belgian Grand Prix qualifying. Verstappen was aided by team-mate Isack Hadjar for slipstreaming purposes.

Lando Norris has spoken out against the intrusive nature of the paparazzi. The 2025 Formula 1 champion described a recent incident in London as leaving him feeling "violated" The Briton opened up about his shifting lifestyle, the challenges of maintaining privacy and the boundaries he expects others to respect.

Max Verstappen is rumoured to be considering a move to McLaren in 2027. The Dutchman is currently seventh in the standings with Red Bull. McLaren team principal Andrea Stella failed to unequivocally deny the rumours. Stella said there were no talks between McLaren and Verstappen.

Damson Idris has confirmed that "exciting conversations" are already taking place regarding a potential sequel for the Formula 1-based blockbuster. The British actor portrayed rookie driver Joshua Pearce alongside Brad Pitt as Sonny Hayes. Idris revealed that behind-the-scenes discussions are underway.

Lewis Hamilton met a fan in the paddock at the Belgian Grand Prix. The seven-time champion gave the fan a hug and spoke to him about his Ayrton Senna T-shirt. The fan was overcome with emotion as they talked about their first meeting. The video of the interaction has been widely praised by fans.

Williams team principal James Vowles has revealed that absolute transparency is the cornerstone of how he maintains trust with drivers Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon. Vowles was asked how he handles difficult conversations with his driver line-up amid a challenging rebuilding phase.

MotoGP legend Valentino Rossi has revealed his immense pride in Lando Norris following the British driver's Formula 1 championship victory. Norris has openly idolised the Italian since his childhood. The motorcycle champion reflected on the F1 driver's journey during a joint appearance at the Goodwood Festival of Speed.

Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc qualified fifth and sixth at Spa-Francorchamps. The Briton smashed up his car in Saturday's third free practice at the exit of Fagnes. Hamilton said the extensive repair job left his car feeling out of balance on the rear end.

Kimi Antonelli won the Belgian Grand Prix for the sixth time this season. Sky Sports F1 pundit Naomi Schiff praised the Italian for a "solid and well-deserved" drive. Schiff admitted she had initially expected a wider winning margin for Antonelli.

Kimi Antonelli won the Belgian Grand Prix ahead of Charles Leclerc. Lewis Hamilton finished fourth, despite serving a five-second penalty for contact with George Russell. Max Verstappen finished third after being passed by Leclerc during pitstops.

Carlos Sainz has been shuffled backwards by a 10-place grid penalty. Sainz has been penalised for taking on additional F1 power unit components. He will start from 19th on the grid, a net loss of five places rather than 10.

Gianpiero Lambiase is leaving Red Bull to join McLaren in 2028. Max Verstappen revealed he already had someone in mind to succeed him. Red Bull has confirmed that Tom Hart will take over Lambiase's role as race engineer.

Kimi Antonelli on pole for Belgian Grand Prix. Mercedes team-mate George Russell finishes third. Red Bull expected to struggle at Silverstone. McLaren's Oleg Karpov and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc in Q3. McLaren's Fernando Alonso in Q4.

Carlos Sainz has praised Kimi Antonelli for spontaneously apologising after the Italian called the Spaniard an "idiot" over team radio. Antonelli found a slow Sainz ahead of him at Spa-Francorchamps. The Mercedes driver expressed his discontent on the track and on the radio: “Sainz, what an idiot!”

Lewis Hamilton knocked down by a mechanic as he left his pit box. Hamilton had just served a five-second penalty for first-lap contact with George Russell. Hamilton struggled with the front end of his car after switching from the medium tyre to the hard.

Charles Leclerc avoided a penalty for a clash with Oscar Piastri during the Formula 1 Belgian Grand Prix. The stewards judged the Ferrari driver didn't deliberately instigate the contact. Kimi Antonelli’s superior pace saw him reel in the Monegasque and overtake him for the win, with the Ferrari driver having to settle for second place.

George Russell out of Belgian Grand Prix after contact with Lewis Hamilton. Briton blames lack of battery charge that left him a sitting duck on the Kemmel straight. Russell started third at Spa-Francorchamps, but was swallowed by the chasing pack.

Oscar Piastri qualified two tenths behind team-mate Lando Norris at Spa-Francorchamps. McLaren team boss says Piastri's deficit to Norris has "nothing to do with his driving", and everything with its Formula 1 power unit algorithms.

MotoGP race at Circuit Ricardo Tormo takes place on Sunday. Sebastian Vettel will start on the front row of the grid for the first time this season. The Spaniard will be joined by team-mate Felipe Massa in the paddock.

Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli won the Belgian Grand Prix on Sunday. Antonelli claimed his sixth victory of the season at Spa-Francorchamps. Former Formula 1 strategist Bernie Collins praised Antonelli's maturity. Collins said Antonelli embraced the calm influence of his race engineer, Peter Bonnington.

Kimi Antonelli extended his lead at the top of the F1 drivers' championship with victory at the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix. Lewis Hamilton was runner-up after unintentionally causing George Russell's retirement. Mercedes conceded only five points to Ferrari in the constructors' standings despite Russell's retirement.

Mercedes' Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc collided in the first corner of the Belgian Grand Prix. Hamilton was given a five-second time penalty for his part in the incident. The incident is the latest blow for Hamilton in the title race.
